summary: Get a defensible answer out of data you already have, with the quality problems caught before the analysis rather than after.

useCases.title: Analyze a dataset I already have
useCases.message: Analyze this dataset for the question I need answered. Check the data quality first, agree the definitions, show your work, and tell me what the data cannot support.

useCases.title: Make sense of data I have collected
useCases.message: Analyze this dataset around my research question, show its work behind each figure, and be clear about the limits.

useCases.title: Get an answer out of a spreadsheet
useCases.message: Look at this data and answer the question I actually have. Tell me what is solid and what is too thin to rely on.

useCases.title: Turn an export into an answer
useCases.message: Analyze this export for the decision in front of me, and flag any data quality problems before the conclusions.
